messages.text: Why Coventry are not a hopeless case despite miserable start

metadata.summary: Coventry have been dealt an extraordinarily tough opening hand, playing four of the current top five as introduction to their first Premier League campaign for 25 years, the top two away from home.
metadata.content: Nottingham Forest vs Coventry City: Why unusually tough start should not be used to measure Frank Lampard's side | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to content Analysis Nottingham Forest vs Coventry City: Why unusually tough start should not be used to measure Frank Lampard's side Coventry City have endured a miserable return to the Premier League, but all is not lost four games in - Frank Lampard is experienced enough to know that; watch Nottingham Forest vs Coventry City live on Sky Sports Main Event on Saturday; kick-off 5.30pm Laura Hunter Football Features Writer Thursday 17 September 2026 11:00, UK Coventry have been dealt an extraordinarily tough opening hand, playing four of the current top five as introduction to their first Premier League campaign for 25 years, the top two away from home. Arsenal, Man City and Brighton are among the top-flight's established elite. Brighton are currently the league's top scorers, albeit five came against Coventry last weekend. High-flying Hull City are perhaps the only outlier where achievable points were dropped. Frank Lampard's side remain pointless and without a goal heading into matchweek five. "We went one down from a moment of quality. Welcome to the Premier League," he said after defeat to Brighton, the step up in class obviously overwhelming for a squad who could only boast five players with any meaningful Premier League experience (measured as 20+ appearances).
